power semantics: a FLAT base amount. At cast time the caster's scaling stat
(physical→Attack, magical→Magic Power, true damage→higher of the two) is
ADDED flat on top — damage/heal/shield scale linearly, never multiplicatively.
TRUE heals/shields are pure flat (no stat added).

Diamond, so the card is an ordinary attack for its whole life and learns its

trades 24 of that base for a 30-power gated hit, so a lightning board reads
54 across two instances and any other board reads 24. The biggest swing of
the five — lightning is the widest element in the catalog, so the board that
wants this is the easiest one to actually have.

WHY THE SWEEP COSTS A COOLDOWN TURN (re-solved 2026-08-26 — the old Gold/
Diamond blocks were fractional). With every part a whole PL the offensive share
is a multiple of 10 deci, and the reach part (floor(share x 33/25) - share) is
only a whole PL when the share is 190, 220 or 250 deci (then +250n) — 190 is the
SMALLEST legal offensive share an AoE card can carry. 190 costs 250 after reach,
which is all of DIAMOND, so at Gold (200) a size-1 card — no size grant to lean
on — must refund exactly 50 deci. The book's honest 50-deci refunds are one
extra cooldown turn (cooldownRefundStepDeci[0]) or +10 weight (weightPer); the
cooldown turn is the cheaper of the two in play (a 20% cadence loss against a
50% one) and it is the one that reads on the card face, so the sweep is authored
as cooldown 4 at Gold and Diamond both.
The frozen slow is 20 deci of that 190, so damage 34 (170) closes it:
Gold    damage 34 (170) + slow 8 (20) + reach (60) - cooldown 4 (50) = 200 exact.
Diamond same offense + shield 10 (50) - cooldown 4 (50) = 250 exact.
The slow's own family spend at reach is floor(20 x 33/25) = 26 deci, far
under the flat size-1 control cap (100 deci).

def.name: Rimebarb Vigil
def.text: {{Thorns}} 5 — attackers take the stack count as physical damage per hit (their DEF applies) · Gain 32 (+MDEF) magical shield.
notes: THE FIRST THORNS CARD WHOSE STACKS SCALE WITH RANK (2026-08-26), and it is only
expressible because of the Q1 `minTier` migration in the same pass.
THE GAP IT CLOSES. `thorns` sits in the EMPOWER family, which is FROZEN across
tiers (user-locked 2026-07-23), and `autoScaleTier` never scales an empower
magnitude \u2014 so every one of the twelve shipped thorns cards carries its BRONZE
stack count at Diamond too. A reflect is an ordinary PHYSICAL hit (user-locked
2026-08-21): `reflectThorns` subtracts the attacker's armor from the sting and
floors it at 1. So the eight small thorns cards (5-8 stacks) sting for exactly 1
against any attacker with 8+ armor, at every depth and at every rank, and buying
the tier-up bought nothing for the reflect at all.
HOW THIS ONE SCALES. Four `thorns` lines on ONE definition, three of them behind
`minTier` \u2014 `applyAction`'s thorns arm MERGES into a single pile (one pile per
holder, like the DoTs), so the resolved wall is 5 / 8 / 11 / 14 stacks at bronze /
silver / gold / diamond. Each locked line is charged in FULL at and above its lock
and nothing below it (`tierResolved` strips it), so this is a real purchase, not a
discount: the tier-up buys reflect.
WHAT IT CANNOT DO, stated plainly. `EFFECT_CAPS_DECI.empower` is 150 deci at size
2 = 15 stacks, frozen at every tier, so 14 is one stack short of the ceiling and
no authored card of any size can exceed 20. A single cast can therefore never
outrun late-depth armor by stack count alone \u2014 that would need a rate or a cap
change, which is balance-designer's call, not a card's. What a card CAN do is
reach the pile that runtime stacking then compounds: `speedWeight` 14 against a
size-2 baseline of 20 makes this the quickest wall in the book, and a second cast
merges into the first (runtime stacking is intentional gameplay, user-locked
2026-07-20 \u2014 never clamped), so the pile climbs 14 -> 28 -> 42 across casts.
BUDGET, per rank. size-2 grant is a refund that grows with the tier budget
(140 / 170 / 210 / 240) and the weight deviation costs (20 - 14) * 5 = 30 at every
rank. bronze: thorns 50 + shield 32*5=160 + 30 - 140 = 100. silver: 80 + 210 + 30
Every part is a whole PL and the shield line is the only thing the solver moves.
